summary: Busy bridge-approach junction kerb, signed No Stopping, no room to stop.
reasons: Six No Stopping Any Time signs

drivers.seclusion: Exposed junction, house 19 m away and a large building opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is a median or traffic island edge by the bridge; no pull-off or clear ground.
drivers.traffic: Busy multi-lane bridge approach with constant traffic.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time signs all round; no cars parked on this kerb.

sun_shade: Open, with tree shade on the west side.
